Welcome to **Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd.**, a premier chemical manufacturing and distribution enterprise dedicated to delivering high-quality industrial acids and chemical solutions. Strategically headquartered at 102 Sudhan Apartment, Opposite Tejas School, Race Course, in the vibrant city of Baroda (Vadodara) - 7, Gujarat, India, our company is proudly situated in the heart of one of the nation's most prominent industrial and chemical hubs. This prime location in the province of Gujarat provides us with exceptional logistical advantages, empowering us to efficiently manage robust supply chains and seamlessly serve a diverse network of domestic and commercial clients.

At Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd., we pride ourselves on being a trusted foundational partner across a multitude of industrial sectors. Our comprehensive product portfolio is meticulously designed to meet the rigorous and evolving demands of modern manufacturing, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, water treatment, and textiles. By leveraging industry expertise and maintaining stringent quality assurance protocols, we ensure that every chemical compound and acid supplied by our enterprise meets the highest standards for purity, chemical efficacy, and safety.

Understanding the profound responsibilities associated with the chemical industry, our company is deeply committed to sustainable operational practices, environmental safety, and occupational health. We operate under strict compliance guidelines to ensure our processes are as safe as they are effective. Driven by a highly customer-centric philosophy, our experienced team works closely with clients to provide tailored solutions, competitive pricing, and exceptional technical support. Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. stands ready to be your dependable partner in driving industrial growth and operational excellence.
